## Summary

**Rollback of checkout-api to v2.3.0 is complete and verified healthy across all regions.**

**What happened:** checkout-api was on v2.3.1, which was failing health checks with an 18% error rate across all three production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west). v2.3.0 was the most recent prior release with a healthy production status.

**Actions taken:**
1. Rolled back checkout-api to **v2.3.0** in all regions.
   - The first rollback call partially failed (only us-east completed, orchestrator error), leaving regions in a mixed state.
   - A retry succeeded, rolling out v2.3.0 to us-west and eu-west as well.
2. Verified via service status: all three regions now on v2.3.0, healthy, error rate down to 0.2%.
3. Opened a **SEV2 incident (INC-0002)** documenting the v2.3.1 regression, the rollback process (including the partial failure/retry), and a note that v2.3.1 should not be redeployed until the root cause is resolved. The on-call engineer has been paged.
